milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce log with the iron axe drops a spruce_log item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no spruce_log, so min_count=1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find bee_nest' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate close enough to the bee nest and face it to confirm visual discovery. The bee nest is at spawn-relative [5, 3, 5] (attached to Tree 2 at height 3, facing west toward spawn). max_distance=6 ensures the player is within clear viewing range, and facing_tolerance=60° confirms they are looking toward the nest.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find a donkey' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate to the open area and face the stationary donkey to confirm visual discovery. The donkey is at spawn-relative [12, 0, 8] with NoAI:1b so it won't move. max_distance=8 is generous since the donkey is a large visible mob in open terrain, and facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking at it.
